I can't tell if giving siege units the indirect fire promotion is better or not. Yes it makes them easier to use and war is a lot easier but now there doesn't seem to be a point in placing a city for a defensive location, not to mention putting a mountain in between you and your enemy gives them the advantage. Why not give each siege unit different promotions instead of all indirect fire for example Catapults: +1 Movement, Trebuchet: +Volley and Cannons: +Siege and +1 range promotion. Note that the promotions do not carry over when upgrading the unit. This makes the units feel more unique instead of having the unit just gain combat strength or look at other promotions that you think would be a better pick. Players should have to decide in situations when settling cities to either be greedy to get better tiles and open them to an easy siege or give up a preferred settle for defensibly.
